 "rationale": "Long-L stages give about 39 dB each, so roughly 78 dB total. GBW = gm1/Cc is about 4-5 MHz, and Rz pushes the zero out so PM exceeds 75 deg with p2 at about 40 MHz. The large-area long-L input pair keeps 1/f noise low. Current budget is 10 uA ref + 30 uA tail + 50 uA second stage = 90 uA, about 180 uW at 1.98 V. A high-gm/Id PMOS output device and the NMOS sink keep low Vdsat for swing."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.0, 4.0),       # input pair L (area -> flicker noise)
    "Itail": (30e-6, 16e-6, 50e-6),
    "I7":    (50e-6, 30e-6, 80e-6), # second-stage current
    "gmidp": (13.0, 9.0, 15.0),     # PMOS mirror / M7 gm/Id (low Vdsat for swing)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 14.0),     # NMOS bias / tail / M8 gm/Id
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Cc":    (6e-12, 3e-12, 10e-12),
    "kz":    (1.3, 0.8, 3.0),       # Rz = kz*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7 ... scaled
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    Ih = It / 2

    # NMOS bias family (same gm/Id, L -> ratioed mirrors)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.7, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and second stage (same gm/Id, L)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=0.85)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + CL / Cc) / gm7 * 0.5 + 1.0 / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "nt", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # first stage: vinn side drives diode so vinp is non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M2", "nd", "vinn", "nt", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "nt", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (CL * Cc + C1 * (CL + Cc)))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (1.0 / gm7 - Rz))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z))) if z < 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    power = 1.8 * (Iref + It + I7)
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds)) / 2)
    psrr = gain - 6
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.15
    th = math.sqrt(16 * 1.38e-23 * 300 / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    fl = math.sqrt(2 * (1e-12) ** 2 / (m1.W * m1.L))   # rough ~1uV/rtHz*um at 1 kHz per um^2
    noise = math.sqrt(th ** 2 + fl ** 2)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "power": power, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise}
